thread:
leah: Heads-up: planning the Tailwind launch next week. want to couple social launch posts + a short "office hours" demo. experiment idea: three arms with different credit sizes and personalization: 1) 100 starter credits (baseline), 2) 250 credits + generic prompt pack, 3) 250 credits + verticalized prompt pack + personalized onboarding email. primary metric: 7-day active workspaces; secondary: prompt reuse rate and avg tokens/session. thoughts?

oman: I like the personalization arm. can we also gate the replay in one variant to test friction? e.g., replay unlocked after claim vs open to all. that might show whether credits drive engagement or just gate annoyance.

tyler: timeline: need final creative by Thu so we can seed cohorts Fri AM. i can do cohort-split but need exact segment definitions. target overall n=2,700 (900/arm). region: NA + EU, exclude internal test orgs and existing paid customers.

jin: routing note: add tag tailwind_launch_v1 to all signups. route high-intent (workspace seats >8 OR demo request ticked) to sales queue. rest go to marketing nurture. also add a support alert if credit redemption spikes >200/hr.

maria: webinar/office hours plan: 30-minute slot — 12min product demo, 10min vertical prompt walkthroughs (marketing/ops/dev), 8min live Q&A. collect use-case and team size on signup. offer optional Slack invite to a Tailwind user channel for participants. replay variant: A=open replay; B=claim-to-unlock. we should balance arms across replay gating too.

leah: creative messaging: hero headline variant A "Ship features with ready prompts" vs B "Tailwind templates to launch faster". CTA: Claim credits + join office hours or Try in Console. also want a short testimonial quote in social card from an early user (internal beta).

oman: experiment metadata for tracking: experiment_id=tailwind_launch_v1, arms=[baseline_100, 250_generic, 250_vertical_personalized], replay_variant=[open, gated_claim]. events: credit.grant, credit.redeem, prompt.install, quickstart.success, replay.watch. attribution window 14 days for downstream conversion. i'll add the tracking spec to the shared doc.

tyler: for the personalized onboarding email in arm 3, we'll include a one-click template installer that pre-selects vertical templates based on the signup use-case (marketing, docs, customer-support). require engineering to pre-populate and test the installer link. jin, can CRM handle the prefill?

jin: yes CRM can pass a use-case param to the one-click link, but we need to define the param set: use_case=marketing|docs|support|engineering. also add wf to mark user as "tailwind_personalized" on click.

maria: nudges cadence: Day0 immediate email + promptpack + invite to Slack channel, Day1 in-app checklist for first prompt run, Day3 targeted email with 2 quick examples for their vertical, Day5 reward message (extra 100 credits) if they completed 5 prompt runs. allow opt-out. keep tooltip frequency to once per workspace.

leah: small ask: include a short micro-survey in the Day3 email to capture first-success signal: did you ship a prototype? yes/no. helps qualitative benchmarks.

oman: measurement: primary = 7d_active_pct, secondary = median_time_to_first_success_hours, tertiary = 14d_conversion_pct. set guardrail: if avg tokens/session drops >30% in any arm vs baseline, pause nudges; likely sign of poor templates.

tyler: creative needs list: social hero, 3-card carousel (use-cases), 30s demo clip, webinar banner, Day0 email hero, tooltip copy. deadline Thu EOD. I'll queue social slots once assets uploaded.

jin: routing rule detail: signups with replay_variant=gated go to gated cohort; ensure `replay.watch` event only unlocked after `credit.redeem` event. tag cohort accordingly for analytics.

maria: Slack community addendum: invite variant for arm 3 only. we'll monitor community activity as an engagement signal. if Slack invites have >30% join rate, consider opening to wider cohort.

leah: campaign ops: can campaign-bot schedule social posts for launch day at 11am PT and a follow-up testimonial post 48h later? also schedule office hours reminders (48h, 2h, 15m).

campaign-bot: scheduled social post "Tailwind templates: ship faster + starter credits" for 2025-06-10T18:00:00Z; follow-up testimonial post scheduled for 2025-06-12T18:00:00Z. office hours reminders set. :white_check_mark:

tyler: final ops note: cap per-arm enrollment at 1k to prevent spillover. set rollback monitors for credit burn and support volume. i'll add experiment to Growth console and post the cohort links here when seeded.

leah: perfect — next steps: tyler -> cohort config + Growth push today, jin -> routing + one-click link spec, maria -> webinar page + Slack invite flow, oman -> tracking spec and event list, design -> creative by Thu. we'll reconvene Wed 10am PT to confirm seeds. thanks team! :rocket:
